text:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "F-1",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-02",
      "change_id": "CH-14",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "Table 1 specifies an allowed visit window of ±1 day for V2.2 (Day 6), whereas OP-02 omits the visit window."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-2",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-03",
      "change_id": "CH-14",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "Table 1 specifies an allowed visit window of ±1 day for V2.3 (Day 10), whereas OP-03 omits the visit window."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-3",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-05",
      "change_id": "CH-14",
      "page": 51,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "Section 6.2.5 specifies a ±24 hour (±1 day) window for 144 h post-dosing PK sampling (V7.2, Day 76), though Table 1 on p. 44 leaves the V7.2 visit window blank; OP-05 omits any window."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-4",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-06",
      "change_id": "CH-14",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "Table 1 specifies an allowed visit window of ±1 day for V7.3 (Day 80), whereas OP-06 omits the visit window."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-5",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-07",
      "change_id": "CH-14",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-07 sets the visit window for V8.1 (Day 90) to ±1 day, contradicting Table 1 on p. 44 which specifies an allowed visit window of ±2 days (while p. 51 specifies ±24 hours for 480 h PK sampling)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-6",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-08",
      "change_id": "CH-14",
      "page": 27,
      "severity": "low",
      "detail": "OP-08 adds '480 h' to the PKTPT codelist, but '480 h' does not appear in the cited quote for 1st dose sampling (it appears in the 6th dose bullet on p. 27)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-7",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-10",
      "change_id": "CH-14",
      "page": 51,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-10 assigns the AE form to PK visits V2.1, V2.2, V2.3, V7.1, V7.2, V7.3, and V8.1, contradicting Table 1 (p. 45) and Section 6.2.5 (p. 51), which explicitly states 'At Visits 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 7.1, 7.2, 7.3, and 8.1, no other data will be collected.'"
    },
    {
      "id": "F-8",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-11",
      "change_id": "CH-14",
      "page": 51,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-11 assigns the CM_STAB form to PK visits V2.1, V2.2, V2.3, V7.1, V7.2, V7.3, and V8.1, contradicting Table 1 (p. 44) and Section 6.2.5 (p. 51), which states that no data other than PK blood sampling will be collected at those visits."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-9",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-17",
      "change_id": "CH-3",
      "page": 24,
      "severity": "low",
      "detail": "OP-17 adds PMAYOPGA to PMAYO for PGA score endpoints at Weeks 4, 6, 8, 10, and 12, but cites the quote for Modified Mayo score (which excludes PGA) rather than the PGA endpoint bullet on p. 25."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-10",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": "OP-32",
      "change_id": "CH-16",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-32 assigns the newly created ADA form only to V3, missing all other required anti-TJ301 antibody sampling visits shown in Table 1 (V2, V4, V6, V8, and V9)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-11",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": "OP-36",
      "change_id": "CH-19",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-36 assigns the newly created DIARY form only to V2, missing patient diary dispensing/review at V1, V1.1, V3, V4, V5, V6, V7, and V8 as required by Table 1."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-12",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": null,
      "change_id": "CH-17",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "No operation adds or assigns a Physical Examination / Body Weight form for Visits 1, 1.1, 4, 6, 8, and 9 as required by CH-17 and Table 1."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-13",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": null,
      "change_id": "CH-18",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "No operations add forms or assignments for clinical laboratory tests, pregnancy tests, C. difficile stool assay, vital signs, 12-lead ECG, blood biomarkers, general concomitant medications, alcohol/tobacco habits, or urine drug screening required by CH-18 and Table 1."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-14",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-37",
      "change_id": "CH-14",
      "page": 37,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-37 triggers PK substudy visits for any subject with PKSUB = 'Yes' at V2, whereas Section 3.1.2 (p. 27) and Section 4.2.2 (p. 37) state that only a dynamically assigned subgroup of 24 patients in Mainland China enter the PK subgroup."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-15",
      "kind": "uncertain",
      "op_id": "OP-39",
      "change_id": "CH-7",
      "page": 49,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "While Inclusion Criterion 4 (p. 34) and Table 1 footnote c (p. 45) require screening endoscopy at Day -35 to Day -6 prior to Randomisation, Section 6.2.2 on p. 49 retains conflicting text stating 'Endoscopy conducted within 2 months before Randomisation is acceptable,' requiring clarification on whether historical endoscopies up to 60 days prior are permitted."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-16",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-40",
      "change_id": "CH-13",
      "page": 94,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-40 enforces an exact 2-hour infusion duration (hours_between != 2) with zero tolerance, contradicting the protocol amendment rationale on p. 94 which removed '±3 min' specifically because it was too difficult for sites to control dosing time within ±3 minutes."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-17",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-41",
      "change_id": "CH-14",
      "page": 73,
      "severity": "low",
      "detail": "OP-41 cites Table 1 on p. 44 to update 100% SDV on PK visits, which says nothing about SDV, whereas Section 11.1 (p. 73) states 100% SDV is performed across the trial."
    }
  ],
  "overall_uncertainty": "Without the separate Laboratory Manual, ePRO/Paper Diary transcription specifications, and IWRS integration specifications, it is not possible to verify which central lab results (such as PK concentrations, ADA, biomarkers, or centrally read endoscopy scores) and daily diary entries are loaded externally versus captured directly in the EDC casebook."
}
